tasks.title: Conversation #103
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm thinking of renovating my kitchen. Do you have any advice？
Woman: you should start By setting a budget. Renovations can get expensive quickly.
Man: That's a good point. I'll also need to decide on the design and materials.
Woman: Yes, and consider hiring a professional if the project is too big to handle alone.
Man: Thanks for the tips. I'll start planning right away.

questions.stem: What is the man planning to renovate?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：男士计划翻新什么？ 定位原文：Man: I'm thinking of renovating my kitchen. 选项分析： A. His bathroom 他的浴室。对话中未提及浴室，所以A选项错误。 B. His living room 他的客厅。对话中未提及客厅，所以B选项错误。 C. His kitchen 他的厨房。男士明确说要翻新厨房，所以C选项正确。 D. His bedroom 他的卧室。对话中未提及卧室，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the woman suggest the man do first?
questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：女士建议男士首先做什么？ 定位原文：Woman: By setting a budget. Renovations can get expensive quickly. 选项分析： A. Set a budget 设定预算。女士明确说“从设定预算开始”，所以A选项正确。 B. Hire a professional 聘请专业人士。女士提到如果项目太大可以考虑请专业人员，但不是第一步建议，所以B选项错误。 C. Choose the materials 选择材料。男士自己提到需要决定设计和材料，不是女士给的第一步建议，所以C选项错误。 D. Draw up a design 设计图纸。男士自己提到需要决定设计，不是女士给的第一步建议，所以D选项错误。
